bureau: Credit bureaus licensed by the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic
note: Kyrgyzstan's Law on the exchange of credit information, signed by the President and in force from 11 May 2026 (24.kg, 2 May 2026), stops credit histories including negative information on an obligation more than two years past its due date, or one year for a credit of 30,000 soms or less; the National Bank's board brought the bureaus' rules into line on 15 July 2026 (Economist.kg, 21 July 2026, as the National Bank reported it). The law's own text, in the Ministry of Justice's database (cbd.minjust.gov.kg, no answer from this environment), and the resolution's (behind Spinform's paywall) weren't read: both sources are press stating the law's rule. The game reads this as two years from the due date (keep 2); the one year for small credits isn't modelled (a threshold amount). No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: 24.kg, President of Kyrgyzstan signs law on exchange of credit information (2 May 2026)
sources.said: credit histories will no longer include information about the subject of the credit information’s obligations to pay a sum of money if more than: ... two years have passed since the due date — for negative credit information; ... The law comes into force in ten days after its official publication, on May 11.

sources.title: Economist.kg, Нацбанк КР сократил срок хранения негативных кредитных историй (21 July 2026)
sources.said: Правление Национального банка КР изменило правила работы кредитных бюро, сократив сроки хранения сведений об обязательствах должников. Соответствующее постановление регулятор принял 15 июля, сообщили в НБКР.
